caseNameFull: Harry P. BEGIER, Jr., etc. v. INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certio-rari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit granted and the parties are directed to adhere to the following briefing schedule. The brief of petitioner must be received by the Clerk on or before February 9, 1990. The brief of respondent *715must be received by the Clerk on or before March 6, 1990, and a reply brief, if any, must be received by the Clerk on or before March 16, 1990.
